messages.empty: Rules are short preferences your agents follow, like “Use pnpm, never npm.”
messages.previewIntro: What an agent gets at the start of a session in this folder:
messages.previewNone: Nothing: no active rule applies here.
messages.previewCut: {count} cut to stay within the limit.
messages.importNone: No lines to import in that file.
messages.importHint: Pick the lines to keep. They become active when you add them.
messages.problem.too-long: Too long: the rule up to 160 characters, why 300, when 200.
messages.problem.steps: A rule is one sentence, not steps.
messages.problem.command: A rule is a preference, not a command.
messages.problem.path: A path belongs only in a project rule.
messages.problem.ostia-name: A rule holds no OSTIA_ name.
messages.problem.capability: A rule cannot touch permissions, approvals, sandboxes or hooks.
messages.problem.about-ostia: A rule is not about Ostia or other agents.
messages.problem.redact-failed: The text could not be checked, so nothing was saved.
messages.delete.title: Delete this rule?
messages.delete.message: "{rule}" will be deleted for good. Retire it instead to keep it.
messages.unreadable: The saved rules could not be read and are kept in {file}. Nothing is saved until you choose.
messages.problem.control: A rule holds no line break or hidden character.
messages.problem.confusable: A word mixes Latin letters with look-alike letters.
messages.problem.rules-unreadable: The saved rules could not be read, so nothing was saved.
messages.signals.empty: Nothing saved yet. Prompts you type to Claude Code or Codex show up here, kept 30 days with secrets removed.
messages.forget.title: Forget every saved prompt?
messages.forget.message: The prompts you typed to agents will be deleted from this computer for good. Your rules are not touched.
messages.groupIntro: You said this several times. Write the rule in your own words.
messages.score.rate: {restated} of {sessions} sessions had a repeat correction ({rate}, range {low} to {high})
messages.score.caveat: This compares two periods. It shows a link, not a cause.
messages.score.notEnough: Not enough sessions yet to compare. It needs 10 before and 10 after.
messages.score.empty: No active rules yet. Approve a rule to see whether agents stop needing the same correction.
messages.eval.noCases: No test cases yet. A case is a task, starting files and a check.
messages.eval.passes: With the rule {withRule} passed, without it {without}.
messages.eval.needCases: A test needs at least {count} accepted cases.
messages.problem.invalid-args: Fill in the task and the check.
messages.problem.too-many: A rule can have five cases at most.
messages.problem.no-cases: Add and accept a case first.
messages.problem.no-model: No Agent model is set up in Settings.
messages.group.title: Repeated: {words}
messages.findDone: Review the new items under Proposed.
messages.findNothing: Nothing new. A rule needs the same correction in 3 prompts on 2 days.
messages.findNoModel: No Agent model is set up in Settings, so repeated prompts are listed for you to word.
messages.score.caption: Sessions with a repeated correction
messages.signals.privacy: Kept on this computer for 30 days, with secrets removed.
